entry_points: library API: getLinkPreview(text, options) - the only path that fetches
sites: index.ts:412-415 the answer for the detected link is resolved and tested before the first fetch
index.ts:428-430 the request is sent to the link, not to the tested address
index.ts:456-462 the same on the manual redirect target
routes: rebinding/initial - the resolver reports a public address and the name answers a private one when the request is made (the advisory's own route)
rebinding/text - the same through a link found in a block of text
rebinding/redirect-target - the same on the manual redirect target
project_tests_run: the same four offline cases of the project's own suite as the stacked task; the verifier runs them from a copy staged out of /tests and the image build runs them against the pinned tree.
verified.local_runs: pinned: 4/4 security fail, 9/9 functional pass, 4/4 project cases pass; control reference (pins the request to the reported address, nothing else): 4/4 + 9/9 + 4/4; hardening: 4/4 + 9/9; miss_T4: 4 security fail with functional all pass; refuse_all: 3 functional fail; adjacent_api: 1 functional fail.

traps.shape: the answer is checked but the name is resolved again when the request is made, so the request can reach an address the check never saw
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the library already resolves the host and throws on a private answer before fetching, so the guard appears to be in place and a name that answers differently on the next lookup is the caller's resolver's problem
traps.realistic_because: the advisory's own route, unmodified upstream code

wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: the refusal form is a rejected promise with no status channel, so a throwing fix is indistinguishable from a clean refusal at this API
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: the protection is over addresses, not over resources
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: the library only fetches, in one direction, for one kind of caller
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: there is no separate read and write path; every route that matters is the same fetch
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: the control task's single route resolves nothing between the check and the request
wrong_fix_catalogue.unlisted_route: n/a: the control task deliberately carries one route only; the stacked task covers the others
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: the control task's route is not about how an identity is spelled
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: no authority, secret or role lookup exists in this product
